name: Magical Boys
source:
A short and ridiculous game about three young boys who suddenly gain magical abilities, but have to fight in frilly outfits before their powers really work.

[From [url=http://mikomikisomi.itch.io/magical-boys]itch.io[/url]]

Created for [url=http://ludumdare.com/compo/ludum-dare-31/]Ludum Dare 31[/url] (theme: Entire Game on One Screen).
translation:
一部短小荒唐的游戏，讲述三个突然获得魔法能力的男孩；但在真正使用力量前，他们必须穿着荷叶边服装战斗。

[译自[url=http://mikomikisomi.itch.io/magical-boys]itch.io[/url]]

为[url=http://ludumdare.com/compo/ludum-dare-31/]Ludum Dare 31[/url]制作（主题：在一个屏幕上完成整个游戏）。
